findings.trigger: Pause transport.run_bounded after Processes.run has checked stop but before the process is registered; call cancel once, then resume process creation.
findings.observed: The child started after cancellation and remained active until a second cancellation. A single cancellation can therefore miss a later registered SSH/rsync child and wait for its long original timeout.
findings.expected: Synchronize cancellation with registration or make later registration immediately terminate/reap the child; retain prompt process-group cleanup on one cancellation.

findings.trigger: Swap the banks parent directory only while Path.open acquires the file, restore the original directory before the read, and leave the bad canonical file metadata unchanged.
findings.observed: The helper hashes a different good inode, then sees unchanged pre/post path stats for the bad canonical inode and reports already_complete=true.
findings.expected: Compare fstat of the opened descriptor with the pre-open identity and check both descriptor/path stability after reading; apply corresponding descriptor checks to chunk reads and assembly publication.

scope: Operational pre-staging of four exact frozen estimator files only; original launcher/bootstrap/development acceptance and scientific worker remain mandatory. Helper use remains rejected until both focused regressions and the existing self-test pass under a revised source pin.
